title.zh: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel

current_state.zh: Israeli PM Netanyahu said he has requested a plan to use cryptocurrency and blockchain networks to bypass possible banking sanctions, while warning that U.S. defense aid will eventually end.
